<h2>Bo Shang, Ph.D.</h2>
<p><strong>Postdoctoral Associate, University of Maryland</strong><br>Civil and Environmental Engineering / Maryland Transportation Institute<br>New York, NY</p>
<p><a href="mailto:bshang@umd.edu">bshang@umd.edu</a> &middot; <a href="tel:+19295200488">+1 (929) 520-0488</a> &middot; <a href="https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/">Website</a> &middot; <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=TVIPpDMAAAAJ&amp;hl=en">Google Scholar</a> &middot; <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5568-1566">ORCID</a></p>

<p>Robotics and AI researcher working across field robotics, multimodal perception, intelligent transportation, and infrastructure inspection. Experience spans sensor integration and data collection, embedded control, computer vision, model evaluation, and cloud and edge deployment.</p>

## Research Interests

<p>Physical AI and field robotics; LiDAR-camera perception; vulnerable-road-user sensing and transportation safety; robotic infrastructure inspection; UAVs, visual servoing, and GPS-denied navigation; reproducible evaluation across sensors, sites, and operating conditions.</p>

## Research and Engineering Projects

<p><strong>Roadside LiDAR and camera perception, CUNY</strong> &middot; Nov 2024 - Jul 2026</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed a workflow spanning sensor capture, temporal synchronization, spatial calibration, background subtraction, object segmentation, and road-user detection.</li>
  <li>Built multi-frame vehicle reconstruction, labeling and quality-assurance workflows, and model evaluation across sites with different beam counts, frame rates, and mounting geometries.</li>
  <li>Separated site-specific configuration from reusable processing and investigated cross-configuration generalization for traffic monitoring and vulnerable-road-user safety.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Robotic inspection automation and structural-defect analytics, CCNY</strong> &middot; Dec 2022 - Dec 2024</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed CNN-based analysis of cracks, spalling, and stains, with AWS inference and a WebODM-based workflow for 3D reconstruction, localization, visualization, and measurement.</li>
  <li>Built an iOS application for controlling a climbing inspection robot and integrated human review into inspection-data workflows.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Bridge Inspection Robot Deployment System (BIRDS), Missouri S&amp;T</strong> &middot; 2020 - 2022</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed UAV and clamping-robot components for bridge inspection, including vision-based girder detection, embedded perception, and control of the deployment mechanism.</li>
  <li>Integrated NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, ROS, embedded Linux, cameras, and robot communication; tested autonomous guidance, clamping, and traversal workflows.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>UAV visible, infrared, and hyperspectral sensing</strong> &middot; 2020 - 2022</p>
<p>Developed Python and Ubuntu workflows for multimodal infrastructure inspection, sensing, and flight-path planning.</p>

<p><strong>Robot-assisted underwater acoustic imaging for bridge scour evaluation</strong> &middot; 2020 - 2021</p>
<p>Contributed Python/C++, ROS, Arduino, embedded control, and computer-vision components to underwater inspection research.</p>

<p><strong>Vision-based UAV servoing and fractional-order control</strong> &middot; 2015 - 2019</p>
<p>Developed and evaluated visual guidance and control methods using cameras, embedded Linux, Raspberry Pi, and fractional-order controllers.</p>

<p><strong>SmartCaveDrone and GPS-denied exploration</strong> &middot; 2015 - 2017</p>
<p>Contributed RGB-D mapping, visual SLAM, and sense-and-avoid capabilities for UAV exploration and robotic archaeology.</p>

<p><strong>Early robotics projects</strong> &middot; 2010 - 2014</p>
<ul>
  <li>2013-2014: AR.Drone and ROS quadrotor object tracking.</li>
  <li>2012-2013: Indoor LiDAR-equipped quadrotor; 2012: camera-equipped quadrotor.</li>
  <li>2011: Camera-equipped fixed-wing UAV; 2010: infrared line-following smart car.</li>
</ul>

## Technical Expertise

<p><strong>Robotics and sensing</strong></p>
<p>ROS / ROS 2, NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, embedded Linux; LiDAR, RGB/RGB-D, thermal, IMU, and acoustic sensing; sensor bring-up, synchronization, calibration, and field troubleshooting.</p>

<p><strong>Software and machine learning</strong></p>
<p>Python, C++, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Linux, Docker, Git/GitHub Actions, AWS; computer vision, 3D reconstruction, visual SLAM, model packaging, and data pipelines.</p>

<p><strong>Evaluation and research delivery</strong></p>
<p>Dataset and configuration versioning, labeling and data quality assurance, cross-site evaluation, replay and failure analysis, human review, GIS and traffic analytics, and technical documentation.</p>
